title: a16z Podcast: The Future of Software Development

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: As software becomes core to every industry.
reader_summary.overview: As software becomes core to every industry, there is a need for more and more software development across practically every department in a company. But as anyone who has tried to get quality software developed knows, that has given rise to a supply and demand problem. Leveraging open source software is a big part of the solution to that problem.

key_points.text: Leveraging open source software is a big part of the solution to that problem.
For example, how do you engage as a company in the open source community; what are your obligations to the project.
And what are the developers looking for?
